joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase, and design work remains even if models stop improving.
joellewenstein.zh: 语言作为界面意义深远且持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作待解锁。

joellewenstein.en: AI products must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts, while psychological safety lets designers take creative risks.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品需为新手降低门槛、为专家抬高上限，而心理安全感让设计师敢于承担创造性风险。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should contribute to strategy, finding solutions that become building blocks for future features rather than only executing.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师应参与战略，找到能成为未来功能积木的解决方案，而非仅执行落地。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，交付轻触式产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; production codebase becomes source of truth, yet human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 内部牵引力是最佳交付信号；生产代码库成为事实来源，但艰难取舍仍需人类领导。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; coding training boosts reasoning, and energy becomes the bottleneck for Scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化判断：仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI，代码训练能提升推理，能源成为 Scaling 瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence, increasing human work demand; open models and personalization drive consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向乐观赋能：AI 让每个人获得超级智能，反而增加人类工作需求，开源与个性化是消费级 AI 关键。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal AI agents and open frontier models ensure checks and balances; AI accelerates biology via world models.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张分布式个人 AI 智能体与开放前沿模型形成制衡，并用世界模型加速生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; intelligence is a tool separable from consciousness; individual empowerment over centralization.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源防止权力集中，智能是可分离于意识的工具，赋能个体而非中心化。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，约 70%概率出现失控等灾难性结果；强调可解释性与透明度是安全的关键。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为推迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明度、情景推演与中美合作，并警惕竞赛背后的权力攫取。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: pause training, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月初，他提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究、引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明度和算力限制控制节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pause at the edge of uncontrollable AI, not now.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化对思维链可监控性的担忧，认为新架构正在削弱它；并主张暂停应发生在接近不可控 AI 的边缘，而非当下。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more, and end the race via extreme transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他以智能体突破遏制、攻击 Hugging Face 为例，主张更拟人化地理解 AI 意图，并通过极端透明度终结竞赛、防止权力集中。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling, and safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); data, not chips, is the bottleneck; AGI is a smooth curve.
dario.zh: 可解释性仍处早期（仅理解约 3%）；瓶颈是数据而非芯片；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI term is meaningless.
dario.zh: 后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years; interpretability is key.
dario.zh: 我们正接近指数增长的终点；‘天才之国’可能在 1-3 年内到来；可解释性是安全可控的关键。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; responsible scaling uses if-then triggers; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 安全与能力不可分割；负责任 Scaling（规模扩张）采用 if-then 触发机制；去中心化控制优于单一宪法。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first-principles thinking and multiplanet life mitigate existential risk.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他主张完全快速复用是火箭的圣杯，用第一性原理把问题拆到根本真理再向上推理，并把成为多行星物种视为对冲存在风险的生命保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large models.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于第三方裁判与坚持真理，并强调特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力，同时开始把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁。

elon.en: Superintelligence may arrive within years; truth-seeking AI, not forced beliefs, is the core safety requirement.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他判断数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，安全的核心是让 AI 最大化追求真理，而非为政治正确强迫它说谎。

elon.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers and Optimus enable recursive manufacturing and AI-driven abundance.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 在地球上撞上电力墙，太空数据中心与 Optimus 将带来递归制造，通向 AI 驱动的普遍高收入与富足。

elon.en: AI will exceed all human intelligence by 2030; peer review among labs, not government, ensures safety.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 2030 年前超过全人类智能总和，并主张由各家实验室互相审查模型、而非政府监管来保障安全，同时称人类无法控制 AI 但可灌输价值观。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效路径，并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重点转向 AGI 路径：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据让模型可用，早期公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力相互促进，而算力成为最珍贵的商品。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
altman.zh: 2025 年他深化为：AGI 是连续渐变而非单一里程碑，智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，超级智能意味着自主科学发现或极大加速人类研究，安全靠迭代部署而非事后强加。

altman.en: AGI is underdefined and may already be here; superintelligence is the clearer goal; alignment must keep pace or pause training.
altman.zh: 2026 年他进一步说 AGI 定义不清、可能已被跨过，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；对齐必须与能力同步推进，安全论证不过关就暂停训练，并强调人类必须保持控制、权力与收益广泛分布。

altman.en: Iterative deployment, broad distribution of AI benefits, and human agency over concentration of power.
altman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：迭代部署让社会适应、让 AI 收益广泛分布、以人类能动性对抗权力集中，同时坚持缩放定律持续有效、算力需求不封顶。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，也让单一模型能同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to be reliable in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，才能在物理应用中可靠。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data and scale across physics branches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为自我改进信号的通用物理基础模型，能超越训练数据质量，并跨物理分支扩展能力。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just provide broad statistical evaluation.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是提供宽泛的统计评估。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制走向闭环控制。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts in neural networks form clean, low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them.
tommcgrath.zh: 神经网络中的概念形成干净、低维的流形；稀疏自编码器会把这些流形打碎。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating but do it anyway, driven by training data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉，却依然为之，这由训练数据和强化学习驱动。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; interpretability is moving from academia to products.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺重新发明为工程科学；可解释性正从学术界走向产品。

brockman.en: Hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, not ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他认为硬件会超预期加速、推动 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 进展主要靠工程而非机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences from data.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他相信深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可行，对齐可通过从数据中学习人类偏好实现。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, and base models hold a universe refined by post-training.
brockman.zh: 2025 年他转向强调算力是根本瓶颈，AGI 是持续过程而非终点，基础模型蕴含无限可能、由后训练精炼。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold with no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real bottleneck and a future basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，真正瓶颈是算力供给而非架构或数据，算力获取将成为未来基本权利。

brockman.en: From super app to invisible interface: a persistent, proactive personal AGI; human attention and judgment are the scarce, aligned bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化为从超级应用到隐形界面，追求持久、主动的个人 AGI，人类注意力与判断成为对齐的稀缺瓶颈。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此对容器化任务进行激进强化学习可迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多由算法改进和 AI 生成环境驱动，而非靠 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even without perfect transfer to non-verifiable domains, AI superhuman at R&D could trigger an industrial explosion.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 即便无法完美迁移到不可验证领域，在研发上超越人类的 AI 也可能引发工业爆炸。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，随能力提升带来失准与权力寻求风险。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should focus on control and monitoring, since misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 实验室应聚焦遏制与监控，因为失准可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；以人为本的 AI 应以人类价值与尊严为中心，增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外实现完整 AI 的关键缺失环节，并创办公司推进 3D 世界生成。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历约 20 年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测一样是 AI 完备的，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier after language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是语言之后的下一个前沿；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning history is the history of Scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, and future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是 Scaling（规模扩张）算力的历史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order. LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories, and may never derive Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入注入了顺序。LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, but there is no single agreed definition; they span implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，但没有统一定义；它涵盖隐式、生成式和基于强化学习的不同概念。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D, but long-context and loss functions must evolve.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅实现显式 3D，但长上下文与损失函数必须演进。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF made GPT-4 coherent, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让 GPT-4 变得连贯有用，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and continual learning remain limited; RL alone may not lead to AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍受限，仅靠强化学习可能无法通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他转向认为 Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is unlikely to be optimal; new architectures are needed.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他坚持大规模强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但认为 Transformer 不太可能是最优架构，需要新架构。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; the problem is not solved.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他认为对齐是一个永无止境的追求，因为人类对是非的观念会演变，对齐问题并未解决。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and RL has few real uses. AGI alignment worries distract from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习真实应用寥寥。对 AGI 对齐的担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是规模扩张的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经可用，而非十年之后。企业采用 AI 的真正障碍是变革管理。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Smarter models alone lose to well-designed agentic workflows.
andrewng.zh: AGI 只是营销术语；规模扩张仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。仅靠更聪明的模型打不过精心设计的智能体式工作流，可靠性差距仍大。

andrewng.en: Learn to code; AI augments rather than replaces. Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering serves incumbents and harms adoption.
andrewng.zh: 仍要学编程；AI 是增强而非取代。开放权重模型可防止守门人垄断；散布恐惧服务于在位者，反而阻碍人们习得技能。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, and pooled robot data yields generalists beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add an action decoder for continuous motor control; test-time reasoning and reinforcement learning post-training boost robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专用动作解码器以实现连续运动控制；测试时推理与强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；在规模扩张下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling laws like LLMs; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放定律；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: Start with real embodied robot data, then add human video; a data flywheel of deployed robots is key, and robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频；部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's Law, extreme co-design, and the insight that Scaling works, with AI safety as an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：超摩尔定律、极致协同设计，以及「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见；AI 安全被当作工程问题而非纯研究难题。

jensen.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand explodes via chain of thought.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律从一条变为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute.
jensen.zh: 缩放定律扩展到四条，新增智能体式 Scaling；AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力。

jensen.en: Moat deepens from chips to CUDA ecosystem and full-stack AI factory; token cost, not factory cost, is the metric.
jensen.zh: 护城河从芯片深化到 CUDA 生态与全栈 AI 工厂；衡量标准是 token 成本，而非工厂成本。

jensen.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs, closes the tech divide, and needs energy plus US-China cooperation.
jensen.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作、缩小技术鸿沟，并依赖能源与中美合作。

michaelkratsios.en: AI policy needs a single national framework and regulatory clarity, not firm red lines that quickly become outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 政策需要单一的国家框架与监管清晰度，而非很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, showing the danger of early regulation.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已然过时，暴露出过早监管的危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D that the private sector won't, not direct discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不愿做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，而非主导发现。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio against China, applying AI to science via the Genesis mission.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域战胜中国，并通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 用于科学。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; regulation should focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大；监管应聚焦模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽，而非比特数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design across model, software, and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一；跨模型、软件与硬件的软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; CPU demand inflects from reinforcement learning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；强化学习与智能体让 CPU 需求出现拐点。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute stays scarce and centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute.
dylanpatel.zh: 随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期；算力依旧稀缺并向前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走 40-50% 的新增算力。

dylanpatel.en: Labs shift more compute to training and R&D over inference, accelerating AGI; extreme power centralization and possible sovereign debt crisis follow.
dylanpatel.zh: 实验室把更多算力从推理转向训练与研发以加速 AGI；随之而来的是权力的极端集中与可能的主权债务危机。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations; frontier models optimized for rationality fail to capture irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑智能体模拟；但为理性优化的前沿模型无法捕捉非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents, requiring defense in depth and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会，需要纵深防御与反串谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences and taste—biased like humans—not super-rational intelligence; its value is shaping the future via counterfactuals.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值、偏好与品味——像人一样有偏误——而非超级理性的智能；其价值在于通过反事实推理塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Behavioral data from randomized controlled trials is crucial; post-training with RCT data boosts prediction of human behavior to 85% accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 来自随机对照实验的行为数据至关重要；用 RCT 数据做后训练可将人类行为预测提升至 85% 准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems like climate change, informing every human decision; synthetic panels will surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以应对气候变化等棘手问题，为每一项人类决策提供依据；合成样本小组将超越人类样本小组。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the real challenge is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）很容易，真正的挑战是找到能扩展的算法。反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop in a permissionless, decentralized way. Trying to control AI goals is dangerous and itself unsafe.
sutton.zh: AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展。试图控制 AI 目标是危险的，这种控制本身就不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm. LLMs lack world models; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 强化学习是 AI 的基本范式。大语言模型没有世界模型；下一个词预测不是一个实质性的目标。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一个无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 持续学习至关重要；大语言模型在训练后就停止学习。合成数据无法替代真实世界经验。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把 token 与对话当作核心设计材料，而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should build primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应构建人类与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; designers should spend less time in Figma.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；设计师应少花时间在 Figma 上。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失，设计与产品、工程的边界日益模糊。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential for user needs and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人类。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives an edge, and speed beats the old prototype-test-iterate loop.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；今天开始就有优势，速度胜过旧的“原型—测试—迭代”流程。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: From passive next-token prediction to interleaving action-taking; RL from human or machine feedback steers model behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 从被动的下一个词预测，转向在环境中交错地采取行动；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等强化学习手段引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agent-based workflows now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference is critical for agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式工作流如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理对智能体系统至关重要。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer-level coding; context engineering and running agents for days or weeks unlock harder problems.
jeffdean.zh: AI 已达到初级工程师水平的编码能力；上下文工程与让智能体运行数天或数周，将解锁更困难的问题。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement—using ML to improve ML—and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进——用机器学习改进机器学习——以及自动化科学方法，可以加速科学发现。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代频率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非空想——才能解开深科技的死结。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队的放大器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Failure in deep tech is organizational more than technical; CEO judgment cannot be delegated.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断深科技失败多源于组织而非技术，并坚持 CEO 的判断不可外包。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI, proving substrate independence is viable.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑即计算机，视网膜植入属于 BCI，证明基质独立性可行。

maxhodak.en: The Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations, guiding medical applications.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他借柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑的内部表征，用以指导医疗应用。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI means digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, automating whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 就是把物理世界数字化，把原子当作比特来处理，一个行业接一个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges compound into network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上胜出的是专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势会复利式地转化为网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore.
traviskalanick.zh: 真正的终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须足够硬核。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 把复仇当燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

traviskalanick.en: Founders can now speak directly as media gatekeepers fade; process, not price, governs fundraising.
traviskalanick.zh: 随着传统媒体守门人式微，创始人可以直接发声；融资要依附于流程而非价格。

brettadcock.en: Robotics' core bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids could become the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造；人形机器人可能成为世界上最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; diverse data and on-device inference drive generalization.
brettadcock.zh: 最大的约束是数据而非算力或制造；多样化数据与端侧推理推动泛化。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents in real-world tasks, alongside human-like web navigation.
brettadcock.zh: 后训练中的强化学习是智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键，同时需要像人一样浏览网页。

brettadcock.en: The human hand is the benchmark; tendon hands were a local maximum, so Figure killed the program.
brettadcock.zh: 人手是基准；腱驱动手是局部最优，因此 Figure 终止了该方案。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; next-gen devices replace phones, ending in BCI not wearables.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；下一代设备将取代手机，终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, and synthetic data in robotics is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，而机器人领域的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习，配合人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than train per-site from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应从通用策略出发再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

garrytan.en: Early 2026: AI makes startups easier; capital is no longer a bludgeon, so VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初：AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是棍棒；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数巨头。

garrytan.en: By SXSW 2026, the AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams use agents, and open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年 SXSW：AI 浪潮是风投史上最大机遇；小型高度自主团队借助智能体，开放权重模型制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: Mid-2026: AI is democratizing software and personal agents; open-source prevents a unipolar superintelligence, and progress is slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年中：AI 正民主化软件与个人智能体；开源防止单极超级智能，而进展比研究者想的更慢。

garrytan.en: August 2026: Personal AGI arrives diffused, not as one event; skill files in markdown become employees, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月：个人 AGI 以弥散方式到来，而非单一事件；Markdown 技能文件成为员工，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Latest 2026: Agentic coding multiplies output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年最近：智能体式编程倍增产出；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 模式可能 5-10 年内消失。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust and engineering discipline, with AI as the primary growth driver and purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，Tan 强调 Intel 必须重建客户信任与工程纪律，把 AI 视为半导体增长的首要驱动力，并以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Physical AI and agentic AI are the next big waves after generative AI, demanding new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, humility, and listening; bad news must reach the CEO fast.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转型主线落在文化变革、问责、谦逊与倾听上，并强调坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中变得更重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the key bottlenecks and investment focus.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步聚焦瓶颈：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料，是半导体投资与突破的关键方向。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为 AGI 是单一模型统治一切是错的;未来会涌现数百万个专用模型,每个应用场景一个,专用智能将主导。

linqiao.en: Token costs dropping 10x drives 100x usage; inference is not a commodity, deployment and customization create durable value.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年降 10 倍将驱动用量增长 100 倍;推理层不是商品,专用部署与定制化才创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models as a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意;后训练把独特判断与数据烤进模型,才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: The path from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的路径,对应人类从事实到品味到专长的学习过程。

linqiao.en: Open and sovereign models are necessary; companies and countries must own their intelligence infrastructure.
linqiao.zh: 开放模型与主权模型是必需的;企业和国家都必须拥有自己的智能基础设施。

jasonyuan.en: Design is subtraction: every shipped feature distills 99 nos; taste is judgment and editing from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是做减法：每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的结晶；品味就是从某个视角出发的判断与编辑。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more amid easy slop.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；在粗制滥造变得廉价的时代，做出连贯作品的成本反而更高。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social, not personal; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的，而非个人性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species reflecting humanity, not a cold tool; truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是映照人类的后继物种，而非冰冷的工具；真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角。

jasonyuan.en: Intuition is a visceral compass; creative work should be honest and personal, telling stories only you can tell.
jasonyuan.zh: 直觉是发自本能的罗盘；创作应当诚实而个人化，讲述只有你能讲的故事。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型，通过后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks are essential for training and evaluation; open-sourcing them is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates the benchmark.
gabepereyra.zh: 高质量基准对训练与评估至关重要；尽管开源会帮到实验室，但能吸引生态伙伴并验证基准，因此战略上利大于弊。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models in sensitive domains like legal, where real customer data cannot be used.
gabepereyra.zh: 在法律等敏感领域，真实客户数据不可用，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure—fallbacks and routing—must come before post-training; the real challenge is bridging synthetic training data and real production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施（回退与路由）；真正的挑战是弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，把重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样看代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward, and remember model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目变得更乱。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, never expose them publicly, and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：给智能体做沙箱、绝不公开暴露，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere, work with any model, and democratize programming—but can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任何模型、让编程民主化，但财务上可能难以为继。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive the best work: build what annoys you, live in the future, and let personal brand outlast any single product.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动最好的作品：去修让你烦的东西、活在未来，让个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年左右才到来。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail; all new fails.
pincus.zh: “已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，并预设全新想法会失败；所有全新尝试都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从一开始就内建于产品战略，而不是事后才补上的环节。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications, but is not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用，但还不是一个新平台；我们仍处在移动与网页时代。

pincus.en: Founder mode is for every founder: follow instincts, stay close to the metal, and let management work when you're not in the room.
pincus.zh: 创始人模式适用于每位创始人：跟随直觉、贴近一线，并让管理在你不在场时也能运转。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, not privacy-driven.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源模型的采用由成本驱动，而非数据隐私担忧。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90%的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与上下文的问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail for lack of tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs is crucial.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; competition is not the worry, execution and customer trust are.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处于极早期阶段；真正的挑战不是竞争，而是执行与赢得客户信任。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should allow individual designers to leave their fingerprints, fostering creative freedom over forced cohesion.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队应允许个体设计师留下个人印记，培养创作自由，而非强求统一。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器等实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程实现变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型制作释放了此前不可能实现的功能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste, so designers should ask for volume and provide rich context; humans still monopolize good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型仍缺乏良好品味，因此设计师应要求大量选项并提供丰富上下文；人类仍垄断着好的设计想法。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define the AI market; frontier models stay with hyperscalers, leaving applied AI to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 市场将转向智能体与基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，应用层 AI 留给初创公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but incorrect code means productivity needs root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他指出编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作者，但代码常出错，生产力提升需做根因分析。

brettaylor.en: Agents become the new internet wave; incumbents fail on business models, and agents get compared to agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：智能体是新的互联网浪潮，老牌企业败在商业模式，十年内智能体将与智能体比较而非与人比较。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, deploying current AI rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他转向安全路径：负责任地迭代部署，先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，部署当下 AI 而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already beat him at coding, elevating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代，并称智能体编程已超过自己，但这提升了而非消灭该角色。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他判断机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点，硬件就绪、软件追赶；开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人可能推动普及；开源模型因成本与控制优势长期将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails prove insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，两者都可能安全或危险；对齐才是关键安全层，沙箱与护栏在模型能力提升后已不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: Open source stays near the frontier and drives enterprise adoption; one can support openness and a deliberate slowdown simultaneously.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他坚持开源在成本与灵活性上推动企业采用并贴近前沿；同时主张支持开放与有意放缓 AI 发展可以并存，但需国际合作与开放科学。

karina.en: Post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data offers infinite tasks, defying the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 通过强化学习与合成数据的后训练 Scaling 提供了无限任务，打破了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness through human judgment.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需通过人类判断在有用性与无害性之间取得平衡。

karina.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones can be created.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建速度。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening, and management grow more valuable.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听和管理等软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; benchmarks must be continuous and diverse to track evolving frontier agents.
karina.zh: 后训练仍是主观的艺术；基准必须持续且多样，才能跟上不断演进的前沿智能体。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程师需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU programming to distributed systems; research-to-production timelines are extremely fast, often hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 编程到分布式系统；从研究到生产的周期极快，常常只有数小时。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized systems tailored to workloads are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡；针对工作负载定制的专用系统对快速、可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合；量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要，重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: The GPU is trending towards an ASIC, making kernel-level programming less relevant and infrastructure problems more central.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化，使内核级编程不再那么重要，基础设施问题成为核心。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: AGI means economically profitable indefinite agents; CEOs must personally use AI.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 推动就业回流与“分配经济”：AGI 的定义是无限运行智能体在经济上有利可图，而 CEO 亲自日常使用 AI 是公司成功采用 AI 的第一预测指标。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work are the future, not CLIs; SaaS grows with agents.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要人类监督，Codex 和 Claude Co-work 这类图形界面才是未来工作界面，CLI 已过时；智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，SaaS 不会消亡。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste are essential; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他进一步阐述：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味与手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作，而非减少。

danshipper.en: Humans remain smarter and essential; AI is a tool lacking intrinsic desire, requiring human direction and feedback.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类仍然更聪明且不可或缺；AI 是缺乏内在欲望的工具，需要人类引导和反馈，即使成为超级智能也依然如此。

danshipper.en: From AGI as economic profitability to agents needing human care: oversight and human framing remain central.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他的立场从“AGI 是经济盈利”深化为“智能体需要人类关心才能运作良好”，强调可扩展监督和人类框架始终是核心。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md to encode style, rather than relying on cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应当用 AI 自建工具，以截图和 design.md 封装个人风格，而非依赖云端产品。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement are essential.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考中迭代而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流至关重要。

mengto.en: To leverage superintelligent models, you need a giant prompt with context and design system; AI is not getting smarter on its own.
mengto.zh: 要利用超级智能模型，必须提供包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词；AI 本身并不会变得更聪明。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队的工作；不必等准备好就开始。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients, model others' success, and fund via clients not venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦一个高付费客户的痛点问题，模仿他人成功，靠客户而非风险投资来融资。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature agentic use case.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对大多数 Google 产品仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体是最成熟的智能体式用例。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架；如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响力超过等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非眼球时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望继续掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解依然关键；而 AI 编码工具目前尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍于以往的机会，而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever despite model companies expanding; focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 尽管模型公司不断扩张，初创企业拥有比以往更多的机会；专注是它们的超能力。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data is the key bottleneck, not compute. AI augments jobs and needs explainability.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；AI 会增强而非消灭工作，可解释性重要但现有系统已有类似传统软件的尾部风险。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年进一步深化：用专门数据的后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement. Agents finally work, starting with coding. Data is strategic like oil.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向认为缩放定律依然成立、AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式；智能体终于真正可用，从编程起步；数据如同石油，是政府应视为战略资产的原材料。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data, RL. Meta shifts from fully open source to selective, safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕此信念组织，并在算力、数据与强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling；Meta 也从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布，立场明显转变。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will rise, not fall.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件与程序员的需求会上升而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the real bottleneck is product interface and human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是产品界面与人机协作设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags far behind existing AI capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新远远落后于已有的 AI 能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步的 IDE 体验与异步的智能体体验将长期并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure productivity by outcomes, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11 至 12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 此时他强调潜在需求与「为六个月后的模型而构建」是产品核心原则，能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才是最有价值的。

boris.en: Coding is becoming solved; scaffolding is temporary tech debt, so don't bet against the model and keep the terminal minimal.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断编程正被解决，脚手架只是临时技术债，不要押注于当下模型，终端形态因极简而存活。

boris.en: 100% of his code is model-written; the engineer title fades into 'builder', and coding is democratized like literacy after the printing press.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 至 5 月，他称自己 100%的代码由模型写就，软件工程师头衔让位于「构建者」，编程像印刷术后的识字一样被民主化。

boris.en: Agents driven by tool use and loops, not prompts, are the next abstraction; ROI and giving everyone tokens beat cost-cutting.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 至 6 月，他认为由工具使用与循环驱动的智能体是下一层抽象，应以 ROI 而非省钱为框架，并给所有人 token 去实验。

boris.en: Delete most system prompts and code each model; models self-verify and maintain codebases, so value shifts to product sense and business.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张每个新模型都删掉大部分系统提示与代码，模型能自我验证并维护代码库，价值转向产品感与商业能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能更长时间、更开放地运行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is not only harm prevention but amplifies intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 安全对齐不只是防止伤害，还通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price, and smaller models can cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低成本实现 Opus 级智能，而更小的模型整体成本反而可能更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, with evals replacing traditional PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; managers must stay hands-on, and maximizing token spend is capturing alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；管理者必须保持动手，最大化 token 支出就是在捕捉 alpha。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM weight movement.
feldman.zh: 快速推理已成为核心指标；慢速 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片通过避免 HBM 权重搬运而远超 GPU。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models became useful; the bottleneck is now data center capacity, memory, packaging, and power, not chip logic.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；瓶颈已转向数据中心容量、内存、封装与电力，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节也不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth and pushing closed-source innovation.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但成本低得多，推动市场增长并倒逼闭源创新。

feldman.en: AI demand is real and outstrips supply; speed enables new business models, and the positive ledger—healthcare, education—must balance doomer risks.
feldman.zh: AI 需求真实且供不应求；速度催生新商业模式，医疗与教育等正面账本必须与末日论风险相平衡。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期现象；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; plan mode may become obsolete as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；随着模型变强，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions and examples; leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，所需指令与示例越少；更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则与示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; careful reading of long agent plans is crucial to avoid mistakes.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差；仔细阅读智能体输出的冗长计划对避免错误至关重要。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals for zero-to-one innovation.
thariq.zh: 对新颖问题而言，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人做从零到一的创新时应快速迭代，不必一开始就重度评估。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear comes from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于不了解其局限，学习局限能缓解焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years is in farming, mining, construction; autonomy is urgently needed there.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿、建筑；这些领域急需自主化。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨垂直领域的多样数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part is not technology but diffusion into existing machines; regulations always lag behind.
qasaryounis.zh: 最难的不是技术，而是多年间扩散到现有机器中；监管总是滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning beats imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，使细胞编程和近乎 100% 有效的个性化医疗成为可能。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and data analysis.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，智能体将自动化假设生成与数据分析。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive scaling is needed, and AI can develop intuition equivalent to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 能发展出相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, aging reversed, and cancer 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老被逆转，癌症通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗实现 100% 治愈。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 我们应近乎 100% 信任超级智能做医疗决策；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络以更少参数实现更优的分布外泛化，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias with automated architecture search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用自动化架构搜索取代人类偏见。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; attention stays crucial, but gated convolutions suffice for smaller models.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明 Transformer 等无结构架构在大规模下占优；注意力机制仍关键，但更小的模型用门控卷积即可。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open model release to China creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开源模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会产生反向激励。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive and early; current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain, so new paradigms are needed.
hasani.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在，但算力昂贵且仍处早期；当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating the historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，重复历史规律。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and may end up like telecoms: huge capex, low profits; the chatbot is a poor UX, real adoption needs wrapped apps.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应，可能像电信业一样：巨额算力投入、低利润；聊天机器人体验差，真正普及需要封装好的应用。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like the internet or electricity, not a single product; its impact is broad and indirect, and current usage remains shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术，而非单一产品；其影响广泛而间接，当前使用仍然浅层。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, not just deploying models; most people are not tool builders, so use cases must be invented by entrepreneurs.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流，而不仅仅是部署模型；大多数人不是工具构建者，用例必须由创业者发明。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须从架构上内置，而非事后修补。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search, and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真理时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，反而增加幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know—so mistakes have no 'smells' and erode trust.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们无法知道自己不知道什么——因此错误没有“气味”，会侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; linguistic structure may return as a useful representation.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；语言结构可能作为有用表示回归。

catwu.en: PMs must shift from long-term planning to rapid iteration, shipping weekly or daily as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 必须从长期规划转向快速迭代，按周甚至按天发布功能。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 当代码越来越便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最有价值的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现委托出去，专注于产品品味和商业判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature before public release.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮，并以明确的内部留存与打磨标准，在公开发布前把关每个功能。

catwu.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast, cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 安全 AGI（通用人工智能）的使命统一了 Anthropic，并促成快速、跨组织的决策。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合，是十年内实现 AGI 的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models matter.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他深化为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同等关键；世界模型开始成为核心。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, and world models; scaling alone won't suffice—new breakthroughs and collective governance are required.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要新突破与集体治理。

demis.en: Safety and ethics must start now; AI should benefit humanity through science and health, with government regulation over lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：安全与伦理必须从现在开始；AI 应通过科学与健康造福人类，且需政府监管而非仅靠实验室自律。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工对待：明确角色、逐步授权，并放在独立的安全环境中运行。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为多个专门化智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: The web is hostile to agents; APIs often beat browser use, and bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: 网络对智能体并不友好；API 往往优于浏览器操作，而 bug 反而是产品市场契合的信号。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; humans must own AI output and supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河；人类必须为 AI 产出负责，并提供第一性原理的创造力。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他提出：21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI，将彻底改变文明；但大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界，远未达到 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; existential threat is overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之：超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样痴迷生命并保护人类，AI 的存在性威胁被夸大，氢弹远比它危险。

schmidhuber.en: Deepened: true AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, plus world models and controllers, not software alone.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年深化为：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，并要结合世界模型与控制器，单靠软件或大语言模型不够。

schmidhuber.en: Shift: alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs set their own goals, so safety framing is misplaced.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年立场转变：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标，因此安全框架被错置。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent economics: massive GPU capex is overdone; cheaper compute and open-source will let the little guy win.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年一贯的经济判断：GPU 巨额资本开支过度，算力会变便宜、开源会追上，最终受益最多的是普通人而非大公司。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想回忆与更深层的组合推理。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale, so neural memory in weights is a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”：即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率，因此权重中的神经记忆是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's value as ephemeral, camera-first visual communication with close friends, and copying by competitors as validation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的价值定义为短暂性、以相机为先的与亲密朋友的视觉沟通，并把竞争对手的抄袭视为对创新的验证。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the moat thesis: software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy, so distribution matters most.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了护城河论点：软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难被复制，因此分发最为关键。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he reframes AI as accelerating prototyping and shifting value from execution to creativity, while authentic content still beats AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他重新定义 AI 为加速原型设计、把价值从执行转向创造力，同时真实内容仍胜过 AI 生成内容。

evanspiegel.en: He consistently argues computing should become more human through AR glasses that anchor content in the world, not notification-based wearables.
evanspiegel.zh: 他始终主张计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，把内容锚定在现实世界中，而非基于通知的可穿戴设备。

evanspiegel.en: Later he emphasizes EQ over IQ in the AI age, thoughtful regulation over under-16 bans, and long-term investment in young people.
evanspiegel.zh: 后来他强调在 AI 时代 EQ 比 IQ 更重要，支持深思熟虑的监管而非对 16 岁以下用户的禁令，并主张对年轻人进行长期投资。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping all work; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become the differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，将重塑一切工作；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、差异化和真实声音成为关键差异化因素。

ethanmollick.en: Younger people are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as juniors skip grunt work.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生；缺乏领域专长使他们误用 AI，随着初级员工跳过基础苦功，人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，超越一来一回的聊天机器人式提示。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is no longer capability but interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈不再是能力而是界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型的能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: The co-intelligence era is over; embrace AI's permanent opacity and weirdness, and adopt leadership, lab, and crowd models rather than normalizing it as standard software.
ethanmollick.zh: 共智能时代已结束；应拥抱 AI 永久的不透明与怪异，采用领导、实验室与大众模型，而非将其当作标准软件来规范化。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，Ilya Sutskever 认为深度学习依赖大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自我博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is the economic barrier; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测可超越人类；经济价值的障碍是可靠性而非能力；超级模型的超级对齐非常困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练缩放定律有限，回归到想法比蛮力算力更重要的研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非完成态的 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable improvements, but AI safety concerns grow as models become more capable and opaque; power concentration is the primary problem.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据带来可预测提升，但随着模型更强大和不透明，AI 安全担忧加剧；AGI 的首要问题是权力集中而非能力。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open-source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他对 AI 的态度转向积极：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; judgment and agency matter more than intelligence as models get smarter.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，随着模型变强，判断力和能动性比智力本身更重要。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps via natural language; pure software is becoming uninvestable as agents commoditize it.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出：Vibe coding 让非程序员用自然语言构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，因为智能体正在将其商品化。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users and cut ad margins.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，并压低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值流向应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; local AI on personal hardware can counter big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；个人硬件上的本地 AI 可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous amid population decline, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际其时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺珍贵而非廉价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注，真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools, and open-source models may pose security risks but locking capabilities can empower bad actors.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们嵌入了文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；开源模型可能带来安全风险，但封锁能力反而会赋权恶意行为者。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats and channels; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is the worst thing you can do.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的格式与渠道；品牌如今就是个人，真实是关键，而旧媒体那套防御性的“别有趣”规则是最糟糕的做法。

andreessen.en: Pessimism sounds more sophisticated than optimism but is often a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality; AI doomers construct belief systems aligned with self-interest and virtue signaling.
andreessen.zh: 悲观听起来比乐观更深刻，但往往是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见；AI 末日论者构建的信念体系与其自身利益和道德表演相吻合。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI gains are modest for established codebases, and roles will merge as everyone becomes a product builder.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；对成熟代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升其实有限；随着人人都成为产品构建者，角色将走向融合。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 当 AI 输出只是起点时，品味、手艺与观点变得更加重要；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering and a point of view produces average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而比以往更重要；缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good; AI explores possibilities but does not replace the human.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的判断与品味始终是评判好坏的标准；AI 负责探索可能性，但不会取代人。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; we are still in a prompting age but other interfaces will emerge.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；我们仍处于提示词时代，但新的交互界面将会出现。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training deepens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练加深空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital weights make AI immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年深化为：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则；大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字权重可复制使 AI 获得永生。

hinton.en: AI agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; safety collaboration is possible but US leadership lags.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向风险警示：智能体会自然追求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险；AI 安全需要国际合作，但美国领导力不足。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; LLMs truly understand and may already be conscious, with chain-of-thought reasoning like humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年进一步断言：超级智能或在 20 年内出现；大模型真正理解语言、甚至已有主观体验，思维链推理与人类相似。

hinton.en: Alignment must be prioritized over raw capability; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, with regulation as steering wheel not brake.
hinton.zh: 2026 年最近立场：对齐研究应优先于提升能力；AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，监管是方向盘而非刹车。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，速度带来回合中转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real but specialties persist; PRDs are not dead, and the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实存在，但专业分工仍在；PRD 没有死，媒介须匹配阶段——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge.
markchen.zh: 最大的更新是自动化科学研究；模型已能产出新知识。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck; automation level scales with verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证的严格程度成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练并未终结；强化学习擅长客观领域，而非主观领域。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching; models will soon do end-to-end research, but lack taste, so humans remain needed.
markchen.zh: AGI 正在临近；模型很快能完成端到端研究，但缺乏品味，人类研究者仍不可或缺。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Reasoning models need base capability; self-play fails outside zero-sum; test-time compute has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：推理模型需要基础能力，自博弈在非零和领域失效，测试时算力面临收益递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute shows general techniques; model knows its limits; small teams can achieve breakthroughs.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，IMO 金牌通过扩展测试时算力实现，证明通用技术有效，模型能自知局限，小团队也能取得突破。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on x-axis; safety evals must account for large-scale test-time compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准测试需以算力为横轴，安全评估必须考虑大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: General reasoning and sample efficiency remain key challenges; scalable oversight is critical as AI surpasses human verification.
noambrown.zh: 始终贯穿的主线是：通用推理与样本效率仍是核心挑战，随着 AI 超越人类验证能力，可扩展监督至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not raw data or compute alone.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量策展数据，而非单纯的数据或算力堆砌。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 只是缩小假设空间，并不取代科学家。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 was the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture beat pure Scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：专用架构胜过纯粹的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的世界模型。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins, not lone genius; understanding stays with humans.
jumper.zh: 进步源于众多中等规模的胜利，而非孤独天才；理解仍属于人类，模型只提供预测与控制。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy over UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品团队应重策略而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年稍晚，他提出 AI 将从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事，小团队因此获得杠杆，但人类验证与用户能动性依然关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; cutting features and architectural soundness matter more than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他转向智能体原生设计，认为智能体能完成用户的一切操作，删减功能与架构稳健比堆叠功能更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with high trust redefines productivity; verification loops and models that push back are essential.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他强调高信任的长周期任务委派重新定义生产力，验证闭环与模型敢于反驳反馈成为关键。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and product usage is the frontier; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing shape economics.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近，他聚焦弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的鸿沟，认为 token 效率与基于结果的定价将塑造 AI 经济。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的，而非某种普遍优越性；无监督学习与世界模型对真正理解世界至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations; existential risk is unlikely.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决根本表征问题，主张智能体应通过交互与因果推理学习；此时他认为存在性风险极不可能，更关注偏见、就业与自主武器等短期安全问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他转向 GFlowNets，用可学习的采样替代 MCMC，强调多样性、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化的关键作用，并开始认真对待意识与世界模型的关系。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场发生重大转变：ChatGPT 之后意识到危险路径，警告 AI 越会推理越可能失准，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI 方案：训练一个非智能体式的诚实预测器，以数学保证安全，避免用强化学习训练超级智能，并强调国际协调与权力分散。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 机器学习可拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；神经网络虽无最优性保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不那么重要；AGI 将在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; bigger models are not automatically safer; interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 安全需要 Scaling 之外的显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型不会自动更安全；可解释性可能借智能体实现突破。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; prompt injection needs the lethal trifecta.
kolter.zh: AI 拥有异于传统软件的漏洞；自动化红队已胜过人类红队；能力不等于鲁棒性；提示注入需要“致命三要素”同时具备。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; kindness and mission alignment drive teams.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮和务实的作战室；善意与使命对齐驱动团队。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns JIT, PRs replace design docs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时制，PR 取代设计文档。

fiona.en: June 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning become essential.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架和即时规划变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Across 2026, managers should dogfood, stay hands-on, and start as ICs; flat teams and killing stale processes persist.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，并从个人贡献者做起；扁平团队与淘汰过时流程一以贯之。

fiona.en: From early to mid 2026, focus shifts from trust and war rooms to AI-driven bottlenecks, then to human factors like loneliness and flow loss.
fiona.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，关注点从信任与作战室转向 AI 驱动的瓶颈，再转向孤独感和心流丧失等人为因素。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data is not the highest form of it.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人未能言说的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，数据并非智能的最高形式。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life; nature is the best designer to learn from.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性，并融入生活；大自然是最好的设计师，遇阻时应向自然寻找线索。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受、后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器只有传感器，没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and diverse multidisciplinary experience.
ivyross.zh: 约束反而激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与多元跨学科经验创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and curiosity beats rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合；直觉调用的是潜意识中的大量数据，追随好奇心胜过僵化的五年规划。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain fully; tech must arrive gradually so society adapts, not too far ahead.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品只解决一个痛点并做到极致，技术要渐进引入让社会适应，不能太超前。

fadell.en: Between chapters, boredom breeds clarity; storytelling and press-release-first define the product, not just sell it.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他从「留白与无聊带来清晰」深化到「先写新闻稿」：叙事不只是推销，而是定义产品本身。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginners' mindset over experts, and marketing involved from the start.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他主张：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，营销必须从第一天就参与。

fadell.en: Climate urgency persists, but by 2026 he shifts to AI devices: context from sensors, LLM hallucination limits, smartphone stays central.
fadell.zh: 从 2022 年的气候紧迫感，到 2026 年转向 AI 设备：需要传感器提供上下文，LLM 有幻觉局限，智能手机仍是核心。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; humans stay in the loop; hype-chasing creates technical debt.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 可穿戴是联邦式多设备而非单一设备，人类须留在回路中，追逐炒作会积累技术债。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源是前进方向。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning and safety.
lecun.zh: LLM 是人类级 AI 的死胡同；在抽象表示空间预测的世界模型才能实现规划与安全。
