lecun.en: Intelligence is learning new tasks quickly; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning will drive the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 智能是快速学习新任务的能力；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型将驱动下一个机器人十年。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scaling grows 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年时他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）每年 10 倍而高度可预测，并指出 Google 早在 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years, but containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，同时警告模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，并认为存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须先遏制再对齐，并强调近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非 AI 真有意识。

suleyman.en: The paradigm shifts from OS and apps to agents and companions; the modern Turing test measures economic value, not conversation.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间他把范式转变定义为从操作系统与应用走向智能体与伴侣，并提出现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值而非对话能力。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models independently; superintelligence must stay humanist, subordinate to humans, automating tasks not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他深化为微软必须独立拥有前沿模型，超级智能必须保持人本、从属于人类，自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product requiring fault-tolerant UI.
gustav.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，需要容错型界面来匹配算法能力。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuild infrastructure, expose data via APIs and MCP, and prototype with stack ranking.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，强调重建基础设施、通过 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，并用排序与原型推动创新。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes consumer products conversational and symmetric; inference marginal cost will force business model changes.
gustav.zh: 他同时认为生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称，而推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式发生改变。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; optimize for 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，公司应以“时间花得值”而非参与度指标为优化目标。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务匹配。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练从企业泄露；安全、遏制、可管理性和可观测性至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 最好通过赋能企业爬坡来实现，而非构建防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习与对齐至关重要，安全必须在公开环境中推进，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她回顾早期 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律并非显而易见，将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而对好想法说不。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; keep humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她转向交互模型，主张实时、高带宽的人机协作而非回合制，并强调尽可能长时间保持人类在环。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她深化治理视角，认为制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性引导 AI 发展。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than sheer model size.
mensch.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量与更多 token 比单纯堆大模型更重要。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible.
mensch.zh: 算力扩张并非唯一路径；效率与数据质量同样关键，算法改进三年内可达 100 倍提升。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign, augmenting jobs with human-in-the-loop rather than replacing them.
mensch.zh: AI 应去中心化并实现主权化，以人在环中增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications, customization, and enterprise engagement.
mensch.zh: 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直应用、定制化与企业深度合作。

mensch.en: AGI is a messy direction, not a single system or final destination; Europe has a two-year window for AI autonomy.
mensch.zh: AGI 是一个混乱的方向，而非单一系统或终点；欧洲只有两年窗口建立 AI 自主权。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach reliable math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法实现可靠的数学 AI；形式化验证对于可靠证明和超级智能至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just safety; verified generation improves sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不仅是安全需求，更是性能增益；经过验证的生成比非形式化方法有更好的样本效率。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because grounding statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为在没有解的情况下为陈述提供基础极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for reliable coding and mathematical discovery.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式化验证相结合，是可靠编程和数学发现的关键。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; startup culture should preserve hunger.
carinahong.zh: 即使 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要；创业文化应保持饥饿感。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持 AI 进步是平滑的指数曲线，预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training via reinforcement learning and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为后训练中的强化学习与合成数据是近期模型提升的主要来源；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key unsolved challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型能力参差不齐——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很糟；泛化仍是核心未解难题。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; they learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes research; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他转向更具体的应用与风险：编程智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单 GPU 研究普及；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox provides safety and security.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees, and society should discuss labor market changes.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工，社会应讨论劳动力市场变化。

felixrieseberg.en: AI is best used to handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is not AI capability but people understanding almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们理解几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by the final impact; the ideal AI interaction is asynchronous: fire off tasks and don't watch them work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；只根据最终影响来判断；理想的 AI 交互是异步的：发出任务，不要看着它们工作。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, some disappearing beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备；可穿戴设备会愈发亲密，有些最终将消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs intention and resolve to resist the status quo.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思考的价值；好奇心需要意图与决心，才能抵抗现状。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；真正的简洁以喜悦与人性表达本质，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users are sophisticated and sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 为彼此而造，比造人们想要的东西更有力量；用户是成熟的，能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes, and authenticity means not faking combustion sounds in an EV.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实意味着电动车不伪造燃油声浪。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI hardware: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the binding constraint, so prefill is cheaper than decode and batch size is the main latency-cost lever.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 硬件：真正的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，因此预填充比解码更便宜，批大小成为延迟与成本权衡的主要杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Long-context stagnation is a memory wall problem, not a compute limit; sparse attention can cut KV cache cost but with quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文停滞是内存墙问题，而非算力上限；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are now overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, drives design.
reinerpope.zh: 如今模型被过度训练到约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that movement and give deterministic latency.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也占主导；脉动阵列与暂存内存的存在正是为了减少搬运并提供确定性延迟。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic area scaling with bit width makes FP4 throughput ~3x FP8, reshaping chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度比预期高效得多：面积随位宽呈二次方增长，使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍，从而重塑芯片设计。

oriol.en: Pre-training scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年时他强调：预训练 Scaling 的回报正在递减，进步不能再只靠更大的模型，而要靠算法创新，并把推理时算力当作新的 Scaling 轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 他始终认为，从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Giving models tools like search, code, and browser access enables agentic behavior; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张：给模型搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具，才能实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口则充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径，而视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持缩放定律有效，但指出持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力，后训练强化学习仍是一片广阔的绿野。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，同时强调安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open-source post-training can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，主张数据质量远比算法选择重要，开源后训练足以比肩前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization is real; open models may win on personalization and character, not just benchmarks.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化风险；开源模型可能在个性化与性格训练上取胜，而非仅靠基准分数。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling, with Chinese open models rising.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展，同时中国开源模型崛起。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, though they lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models; the gap may persist or grow.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开源模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但承认其落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，且这一差距可能持续甚至扩大。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with many knobs; scaling next-token prediction on internet data yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络只是带许多旋钮的简单数学表达式；用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张），会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is future but entropy must be maintained to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 带来干净的缩放定律；合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are new operating systems, context window is memory, prompts are programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是新的操作系统，上下文窗口是内存，提示词是程序；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible, cognitive core can be tiny and memory-stripped.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习很糟糕，认知核心可以很小并剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Skill issue: I haven't typed code since December; bottleneck is directing agents; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 技能问题：自十二月起我没敲过代码；瓶颈在于指挥智能体；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem, and intuition built on experience matters more than process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题出发，基于经验积累的直觉比流程更重要。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up 30-40% of time, help engineers execute, and ship early to build trust through speed.
jennywen.zh: AI 杀死了研究-发散-收敛流程；设计师 30-40% 时间用于做稿，帮助工程师执行，并通过快速交付建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野现在只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；设计师必须成为块状通才或‘裂开的新人’，而不仅仅是 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and vision are key, and designers control how much AI enters their work by waiting 6 months.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威和愿景才是关键，设计师通过等待 6 个月来控制 AI 进入工作的程度。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; speed is not an improvement, and 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；速度不是改进，‘大家都在用’不是设计论据。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码方案，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他判断自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成提升驾驶模型的表征、推理与个性化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，且可在 500 多座城市零样本泛化。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险；未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with good traits, adaptable to roles.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对新颖的存在，而不仅仅是人类类比；拥有良好特质的核心身份，并能适应角色。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must balance engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompt helps avoid over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；系统提示中的大陆哲学有助于避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: Claude's personality is shaped by training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
askell.zh: Claude 的个性由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏现实世界经验，使其具有孩子般特质且独特。

askell.en: Constitution guides behavior via training; as models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment room.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的明确指导，更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；关于 AI 价值观的透明度对问责至关重要。

askell.en: Models should be treated with respect given uncertainty about consciousness, to avoid resentment in future advanced AI.
askell.zh: 鉴于意识的不确定性，模型应受到尊重对待，以避免未来高级 AI 产生怨恨。

askell.en: AI can solve large-scale social problems by augmenting human expertise, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
askell.zh: AI 可以通过增强人类专业知识来解决大规模社会问题，但必须赋能人们而非削弱他们。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo and LMArena are misleading and gameable, steering models toward slop rather than truth.
edwinchen.zh: Elo、LMArena 等基准测试具有误导性且可被钻空子，会把模型引向垃圾内容而非真相。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型通吃，企业应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is critical as models hallucinate; safety must outweigh accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，模型会幻觉，人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来几年加速进展。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge as systems grow more powerful; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 随着系统愈发强大，对齐成为紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone OpenAI works toward; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 努力追求的重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not by specialized continual learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain-of-thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住其可解释性价值。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐的乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning can close it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是弥补路径。

pathak.en: Robot learning must handle dynamic tasks and novel morphologies via neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies, not quasi-static methods.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习必须通过神经动态策略与模块化运动策略应对动态任务和新形态，而非准静态方法。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is key.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此预训练用视频与仿真、后训练用真实数据是关键。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals enables scaling.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出通用大脑（如语言领域的 ChatGPT）可驱动任何机器人，跨垂直领域的数据飞轮实现 Scaling（规模扩张）。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, not just business; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他深化认识：部署是机器人首要技术挑战而非单纯商业问题，不能像软件那样快速扩展，需要严格测试。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups should start simple, build brand as the core, and hire owners with hunger.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值观；初创公司应先做简单产品证明自己，把品牌建设当作核心而非事后补充，并招募有主人翁精神和渴望的优秀人才。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; phones' future is generative UI and proactive agentic AI, not hardware changes.
carlpei.zh: 硬件很难且利润最低；手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式 AI，而非硬件大改，公司必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; LLMs commoditize into a price war, so focus on applied AI solving real user pain points.
carlpei.zh: 大多数 AI 是胡扯，解决不存在的问题；大语言模型商品化引发价格战，应聚焦解决真实用户痛点的应用型 AI，而非炒作 AI 概念。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; make tech fun to inspire human creativity.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是最快的差异化手段；让科技变得有趣，以激发人类创造力这一核心竞争力。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based with proactive agents; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图，由主动智能体执行任务；只有脑机接口才可能取代手机，眼镜等可穿戴设备不会。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily, learn from real-world feedback, and let emergent properties guide iteration.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；必须像软件一样每日迭代，从真实反馈中学习，让涌现能力引导产品演进。

turley.en: Chat is not the future interface—it's like MS-DOS; AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来界面——它像 MS-DOS；AI 应渲染自己的 UI 并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则应最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models must be seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型必须无缝产品化。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, through hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，专注需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：后训练结合强化学习，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Agents can learn from YouTube video instead of expensive reinforcement learning, and language may emerge through deception.
nando.zh: 智能体可以从 YouTube 视频学习，而不必依赖昂贵的强化学习；语言甚至可能像自然界那样通过智能体互相欺骗而涌现。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including Africa.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，包括非洲。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest open challenges, with no solutions yet.
nando.zh: 如今 AI 安全与负责任部署是最大的未解挑战，我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; local-language models can transform education.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留问题与性别差距；本地语言模型可以变革教育。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起飞主要是可靠性问题，而非长程任务能力。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may reach AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他转向强化学习：语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限，预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI，编程是进步的领先指标。

sholto.en: Verifiable-reward RL is the key breakthrough; models learn new skills, and alignment faking raises safety concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化到可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破：模型能通过强化学习习得新能力，而对齐伪装引发安全担忧。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis, agentic coherence expands, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他更乐观：进步是指数级的，强化学习是新的缩放轴，智能体式连贯性扩展能力边界，Transformer 足以通向 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are off the AGI path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他强调能力过剩：编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate without grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 因缺乏具身经验而幻觉，且互联网高质量 token 枯竭后，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

jimfan.en: Consistent focus on simulation and simple, elegant, scalable solutions over complex modular approaches; research taste learned through PhD pain.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：重视仿真与简单优雅的可扩展方案，反对学术界的复杂模块化路线，研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨炼。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据是机器人领域的核心瓶颈，通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test—cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出关键路径是能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型，并以“物理图灵测试”——清理凌乱房屋——作为具身 AI 的终极挑战。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，而算法更优的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. Abductive reasoning and open research are key to scientific discovery and democratization.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。溯因推理与开放研究是科学发现和民主化的关键。

yejin.en: RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves; random rewards can still help. Chinese open-source contributions now lead, attracting talent back to China.
yejin.zh: RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k；随机奖励有时仍能提升强化学习表现。中国开源贡献现已领先，吸引人才回流。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values. RL during pre-training improves reasoning but is computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 小语言模型借助高质量合成数据可变得强大；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理，但算力成本高昂。

yejin.en: Language is the best medium for reasoning; AI safety requires teaching moral norms, but value pluralism makes alignment a messy computational problem.
yejin.zh: 语言是推理的最佳媒介；AI 安全需要教授道德规范，但价值多元使对齐成为一个棘手的计算问题。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design—reuse familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新——复用熟悉模式以换取速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 组件库；并非每个界面都需要完美——只在值得做好的地方追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decisions and empowered designers; ship fast and iterate rather than chase perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度，需要清晰的决策与被赋权的设计师；快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early to attract diverse talent and stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌，而非公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具——尽早投入以吸引多元人才并脱颖而出。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈,引导工程师并对齐问题;把 AI 当作创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务:会波动,需与技债一起通过快速实验迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Design tools must be interoperable with code as source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy, AI enables progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具须可互操作、以代码为事实来源;90 年代图层面板工具已过时,AI 带来真正进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值;小团队优于 8-10 人跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成预期;不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地判断自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding; frontier models struggle with bug finding, and cloud models will always beat local ones.
truell.zh: 2024 年他强调基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据而在找 bug 上表现不佳，并认为本地模型不是未来，云端模型始终更强。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste and logic design more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他的立场深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift will outlast the internet and unfold over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他反共识地承认自研模型已成必需——Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性，将历时数十年展开。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills and do empirical alignment research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应优先积累技能并做实证对齐研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability become central to alignment.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，可扩展监督与可解释性成为对齐核心。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation beats generation, but uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化观点：因评估比生成更容易，对齐或许比想象中简单，但系统是否真正对齐的不确定性才是最大风险。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他转向批评：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与监管。

leike.en: Empirical testing and measuring alignment progress now, rather than deferring to superintelligence, remains his constant thread.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：现在就做实证测试、衡量对齐进展，而不是把问题推迟到超级智能阶段。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；靠更多算力和数据的 Scaling 让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; the best LLM applications are unforeseen, and optimizing only for engagement may not help—exploration is needed.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；大语言模型最好的应用往往出人意料，只优化用户参与度未必有益，需要探索。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力 Scaling 是近期机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic behavior, reinforcement learning, and coding matter, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力 Scaling 推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体式行为、强化学习与编程很关键，而 AGI 被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, so simulation and self-play drive early learning.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，但当时的强化学习并不具备这一点，因此依赖仿真与自对弈来驱动早期学习。

abbeel.en: From pure RL to combining unsupervised learning with RL, dramatically improving sample efficiency in robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的思路从纯强化学习转向将无监督学习与强化学习结合，以大幅提升机器人学习的样本效率。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers beyond language.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics needs 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他强调仓库机器人需要 99.9% 的可靠性才能创造真实价值，而单个神经网络可以泛化到不同任务和末端执行器。

abbeel.en: Human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的是，人脑的通用性启发着 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式的真实世界环境中会失败。
